results.title: 'Chasing big totals is good for cricket': Sanath Jayasuriya
results.description: Sanath Jayasuriya appreciates the rising trend of teams successfully chasing large totals in white-ball cricket. He acknowledges the impressive performance of India and the potential of Abhishek Sharma in leading future success. The Sri Lankan team has gained confidence from their recent matches, boosting their chances in upcoming series. Jayasuriya believes India will perform well in future series against New Zealand.

results.title: Week 11 Roundup: MCC rolls past Heritage, Merritt Island finishes 10-0
NBA Notes: Mavericks, Kyrie Irving, Wizards, AJ Dybantsa, Nets
results.description: Kyrie Irving had been working his way back into form. Friday looked a lot more like the version the Mavericks were waiting for. Irving scored 16 of his 35 points in the fourth quarter and added nine assists as Dallas handed the Rockets their first loss, 116-111.

results.title: Messiah Hampton Arrest: Why Was Oregon WR Arrested Ahead of Northwestern Matchup?
results.description: The Oregon Ducks will be without wide receiver Messiah Hampton for Saturday’s game against the Northwestern Wildcats. The Springfield Police Department arrested the freshman on charges of reckless driving and eluding police, according to The Oregonian’s Ryan Clarke.

results.title: Youri Tielemans comes to Michael Carrick's defence, backs him to continue as head coach amid subpar results
results.description: Manchester United are all set to take on Chelsea FC in the Premier League. The arch-rivals will take on each other at Stamford Bridge in London on October 31st, and both sides will look to put in a good showing in the clash. It is worth noting that Manchester United have been struggling in recent weeks.
